name: zan-workflows
description: Company project and stateless functional TAPD workflows, plus MR review, debug token, identity, and memory skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Company project and functional TAPD workflows.
interface.longDescription: Bundles project context; six function-like TAPD skills for preparing, implementing, automatically locating or creating test-submission Wiki content, submitting, going live with Wiki online-state maintenance, and handling one or more Bugs on one fixed branch after a concise scope checklist confirmation; plus GitLab MR review, debug tokens, team identity, and project memory workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use the appropriate Zan workflow skill for this task.
Before handling one or more TAPD Bugs, show a concise project/repository, branch, and scope checklist and wait for confirmation; then handle confirmed Bugs sequentially on the supplied fixed branch.
Resolve and scope each TAPD work item before changing code.
Repair, automatically locate or create the required TAPD Wiki, submit for test, or merge to master and maintain its online field with the matching functional skill.
